When  I  was  in  high  school,  I  read  this 
 book  called  How  to  Make  Friends  and 
 Influence  People.  And  I  think  the  second 
 chapter  or  something  is  Call  People  by 
 Their  Name.  It's  their  favorite  word  in 
 the  whole  language.  There  was  a  guy  who 
 stopped  his  car,  got  out  and  was  like, 
 "Dude."  I  had  seen  him  9  months  earlier 
 in  the  casino.  And  I  was  like,  "Oi."  And 
 he  was  like,  "No  way."  And  I  was  like, 
 "Solar  sales."  And  he  was  like,  "Yes." 
 Everybody  was  like, "Holy  that  was 
 insane."  He  thought  it  was  insane,  too. 
 Like  when  people  die,  they're  like,  "I 
 just  want  to  be  remembered."
